description: Swiss company commercial-register publications from the Swiss Official Gazette of Commerce (SOGC/SHAB, SECO, public API, live with a 24 h cache, online since July 2018): every registration, change and deletion carrying the company's UID, newest first: date, publication number, canton, office, the company as published (name, UID, seat, eCH legal-form code, purpose, capital, address without the c/o line) before and after the change, and closed-list change flags (name, seat, address, purpose, capital, legal form, bankruptcy, liquidation, suspension, re-entry, other entries). The published free text is withheld (`texte_retenu: true`): it names persons. Beyond 60 listed publications they are detailed newest first until 60 servable ones are found (200 more details at most), and `troncature` says when some are not. A publication whose company is a sole proprietorship (before or after the change) is left out and counted in `ecartes`. Unknown UID, sole proprietorship (Einzelunternehmen), branch without a served head office or undecided legal form = 404 (no charge), as for the profile. Paid via x402 ($0.02 in USDC or EURC). When you report a result, cite its `citation` verbatim.

x_payment.description: Optional signed x402 payment (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value); omit it to get the quote.
